column3: “In the days of” is rendered “during the reigns of.”
“Have become estranged backward” is rendered “have turned away from Him”; NASB supplies “from Him.”
“Will you increase rebellion” is rendered “As you continue in your rebellion.”
“Like a little” is joined to “survivors” as “a few survivors.”
“To appear before Me” renders “to present yourselves [before] my face”; “from your hand” becomes “of you.”
“An offering of worthlessness” is rendered “worthless offerings.”
“My soul hates” is rendered “I hate,” and “new moons” as “new moon festivals.”
NASB adds “in prayer”; “are full of blood” is rendered “are covered with blood.”
“From before my eyes” is rendered “from My sight.”
“Set right the oppressor” is rendered “Reprove the ruthless”; the meaning is uncertain.
“The utterance of” is rendered “declares,” and “the Lord Yahweh” as “the Lord GOD.” “I will ease myself” is rendered “I will be relieved.”
“It will be called to you” is rendered “you will be called.”
“A crushing” is rendered as a verb, “will be crushed.”
“For” is rendered “Surely,” and the change from “they” to “you” is smoothed into “you” throughout.
